Title: Suresh's Day

Cast

1. Suresh - 35 years, prince, son
Look: golden crown, red royal robe
2. Hema - 31 years, princess, daughter
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress
3. Nitin - 29 years, friend
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
4. Shalini - 58 years, queen, mother
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
5. Manoj - 44 years, general
Look: iron armour, red turban

Places

1. The training ground - an earth ground, a rack of weapons

Scene 1: The training ground - Day

[Suresh stands on the training ground. Hema and Shalini stand near him.]

Hema: "Let's do something fun today."

[Suresh practises sword fighting.]

Suresh (softly): "That's great!"

[Suresh draws his bow and shoots an arrow at the target.]

Shalini: "Careful!"

[Suresh mounts his horse and gallops away.]

Suresh: "Let's see."

[Suresh swings his sword from the saddle of his horse.]

Suresh: "Show me too!"

[Suresh shoots an arrow from his galloping horse.]

Shalini: "Well done!"

[Hema rides into the training ground on her horse.]

Hema: "What a day to remember!"
